seo.title: Kawaii Sticker Maker – Cute Die-Cut Stickers, PNG
seo.description: Make cute kawaii stickers with soft pastels, rounded shapes and happy faces. Download a transparent PNG with a white die-cut border, ready to cut or print.

intro: The kawaii style is Japanese-inspired cute: soft pastel colors, rounded shapes and simple happy faces. Animals, food and everyday objects all get big eyes and gentle smiles, so a plain idea turns into something you want to stick on a laptop.

Describe what is on the sticker, add a short word or phrase if you like, and PiCraft makes a die-cut design with a white border. You download a transparent PNG at 2048×2048 px and a 3×3 inch print file at 300 DPI.

designNotes.title: Describe one character doing one thing
designNotes.description: "A tiny fox reading a book under a mushroom" gives the style a clear story. A crowd of characters shrinks each one.

designNotes.title: Keep any text short
designNotes.description: A single word such as "Bookworm" or a short phrase of two or three words stays legible. Long text can come out garbled, so proofread it.

designNotes.title: Add food and plants for charm
designNotes.description: Mushrooms, donuts, clouds and leaves are classic kawaii companions that make the sticker feel complete.

faq.q: Is kawaii the same as chibi?
faq.a: Not quite. Kawaii is a general cute look with soft colors and simple faces. [Chibi anime](/create/sticker-maker/chibi) draws characters with oversized heads and tiny bodies.

faq.q: Will it cut cleanly on a Cricut?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the PNG to Design Space as a Print Then Cut image, print it on printable sticker paper and let the machine cut around the white border. Cut lines are not included in the file. See [how to prepare sticker artwork](/blog/sticker-artwork-print-and-cut).

faq.q: Can I make a whole sheet?
faq.a: Each generation is one sticker. Place several PNGs on a page in your print software.

faq.q: Can I sell kawaii stickers?
faq.a: You can use your designs commercially if your input does not infringe anyone else's rights. Avoid trademarked characters, such as well-known cartoon mascots.

faq.q: Is chibi the same as anime?

faq.q: Is it different from kawaii?
faq.a: Kawaii focuses on simple, soft cuteness, while chibi has anime-style proportions and shading. Compare it with [kawaii](/create/sticker-maker/kawaii).

faq.q: Can I sell chibi stickers?

faq.q: Can I print a sheet of different characters?
faq.a: Each generation is one design, so a set of characters means one generation per character. Place the PNGs on one page in your print software or in Cricut Design Space, then print the sheet on sticker paper. Using the same style for each keeps the set consistent.

faq.a: Try [hand-drawn doodle](/create/sticker-maker/doodle) for light pen sketches, or [watercolor](/create/sticker-maker/watercolor) for soft paint.

faq.q: Can I print a sheet of different stickers?
faq.a: Each generation is one design. Place several PNGs on one page in your print software or in Cricut Design Space, then print the sheet on sticker paper. A set of woodcut stickers with the same heavy black lines makes a neat matching pack.
